::: {.callout-important title="Use your shop process"}
This is not a safety guide. Follow your teacher, training, and local rules.
:::

## Pick your plan

- **Level 3:** use the [current premade plan](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1rdGC6nsCR6Z5DtoN071NhLQZxIc3XbFz0cQT_RCSFDs/edit?gid=452419533#gid=452419533).
- **Level 4:** use your approved CAD drawing.

## 1. Lay out

![](../../assets/phone-holder/01-layout.svg){fig-alt="A ruler and square mark the parts on the wood."}

Mark the outside edges, holes, and slots. Check every size.

## 2. Cut the parts

![](../../assets/phone-holder/02-cut.svg){fig-alt="A hand saw, scroll saw, and band saw can cut the parts."}

Cut the stock and outside shapes with the tool your teacher chooses.

## 3. Drill the opening

![](../../assets/phone-holder/03-drill.svg){fig-alt="A drill press makes the round start of an opening."}

Drill the marked opening.

## 4. Cut the slots

![](../../assets/phone-holder/04-notch.svg){fig-alt="A coping saw or scroll saw cuts the slots."}

Cut the slots that join the two parts.

## 5. Shape the edges

![](../../assets/phone-holder/05-edge-sander.svg){fig-alt="An edge or belt sander smooths an outside edge."}

Shape the outside edges. Keep checking the drawing.

## 6. Finish sand

![](../../assets/phone-holder/06-finish-sanding.svg){fig-alt="Hand sanding and sanding machines finish the surfaces and curves."}

Smooth the faces, edges, and curves with the chosen tool.

## 7. Fit and finish

![](../../assets/phone-holder/westdale/basic-phone-holder.jpg){fig-alt="A simple two-part holder supporting a phone."}

Join the parts. Test the holder with the phone. Paint or finish it if required.

## Submit

[Submit the Onshape link, isometric image, and finished photo](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1NgAOEpUvRkkanlb8MvY5porLpp18FNvFNbXxHZ6il-4/edit?tab=t.0).

The simple design comes from the [Westdale Cell Phone Holder Project](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1s9BFBX40vxdu2WpLCki3DKvmHzcZiEBl/view?usp=sharing). Use the current premade plan for current sizes and steps.
